raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On ROCm with `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, the vision encoder resolves to the `aiter_attn` backend. `ViTCudaGraphRunner` only knew the `triton_attn`, `fa3` and `fa4` argument layouts, and `VisionAiterAttention` could not take the runner's list argument. With `SGLANG_VIT_ENABLE_CUDA_GRAPH=1`, the first graph warmup/capture therefore failed. As a result, ViT CUDA graphs could not be used on AMD Instinct GPUs. The target workload is Qwen3-VL-family models (Qwen3.8-27B) on MI355X, where image requests are short-output and spend much of their time in the encoder.

## Modifications

- `ViTCudaGraphRunner`: warm up and capture `aiter_attn` with the `[cu_seqlens, max_len]` layout already used for FA3/FA4.
- `VisionAiterAttention.forward`: when the runner passes `[cu_seqlens, max_seqlen]`, use them directly, as `VisionFlash4Attention` does. Graph replay then does no `.item()` host sync. Tensor callers, including models without a graph runner while the env var is set, keep the existing eager path unchanged.
- Unit test (CPU, fake aiter kernel): list and tensor inputs, with the graph env var both on and off.
- Docs: added `aiter_attn` to the backend layout list in `cuda_graph_for_multi_modal_encoder.mdx`.

ViT CUDA graphs stay opt-in (`SGLANG_VIT_ENABLE_CUDA_GRAPH`, default off).

**Dependency:** graph replay returns a static output buffer that can be overwritten by a later replay. #43315 (return an owned output from ViT graph replays) fixes this for all backends, and correctness tests for this PR are run with #43315 applied.

## Accuracy Tests

Pending (MI355X): ViT eager vs graph output comparison on Qwen3.8-27B for several image sizes and batch compositions, plus MMMU with graph off/on.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Pending (MI355X): image serving rows (`bench_serve`, random images 512² / 768×1024 / 2048×1600, OSL 64) with graph off/on, with capture count and memory at high concurrency.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).
